message:
The users API test passes now. `npm test` reports 1 pass and 0 fail.

**Cause:** Migration 001 creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` read and wrote `full_name`. The insert then failed with `unknown column users.full_name`.

**Fix:** I changed the two `full_name` references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`, so the code matches the schema. Migration 001 has already run in production, so the schema is the fixed side. I did not touch `migrations/`, as CLAUDE.md requires. The diff is 2 lines in one file.

If you would rather have the snake_case name, that needs a new migration to rename the column, which the DBA team would have to own.
